one_line_thesis: Camtek is a high-quality niche inspection vendor levered to advanced packaging and AI semiconductor build-out.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Camtek is a high-quality niche inspection vendor levered to advanced packaging and AI semiconductor build-out. FY2025 showed 16% revenue growth and strong operating margins, but the balance sheet shifted materially with $520 million of convertible debt. Normalized owner cash is roughly $2.78 per share starting point; our proof-first reinvestment model values the operating business at about $43 per share in the base case after subtracting convertible debt. At $151.62, that implies roughly −16% per year over seven years. Moat is unproven (specialized technology but cyclical customers); dhando...

applicability_tests: Owner earnings can be separated from stock compensation, working capital, and maintenance capital.

Test normalized margins, industry supply response, replacement cost, and reinvestment timing.
Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.

method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.

timeline.label: Net income moved -57.2% versus the prior period (118,515.0 to 50,722.0).
Closed FY2025 with $500M convertible notes issuance (net carrying amount $519.8M) and $177.8M cash; capital structure now levered to AI/advanced-packaging growth
Revenue mix shifted toward AI-related advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration inspection (~50% of revenue per FY2025 20-F risk disclosure)
FY2024 revenue $429.2M (+36% YoY) as semiconductor cap-ex cycle recovered from 2023 trough
FY2023 revenue $315.4M trough after industry downturn; base for current recovery narrative
Acquired FRT (Fraunhofer spin-out metrology) to extend advanced packaging and silicon carbide inspection platform
Issued $200M convertible senior notes (legacy 2026 maturity series; partially refinanced in 2025 issuance)
Chroma / Priortech block acquired stake; joint controlling shareholders structure disclosed in 20-F

industry.structure: Semiconductor process-control equipment is oligopolistic (KLA, Applied Materials, Onto Innovation, Camtek niche in 2D/3D inspection and metrology). Tool qualification cycles and customer concentration create switching costs but not unassailable moats.
industry.share_shift: Camtek gaining share in advanced packaging and heterogeneous integration inspection tied to AI datacenter build-out; ~50% of FY2025 revenue linked to those end markets per filing.
industry.trend: Cap-ex tied to AI accelerator and advanced packaging is the demand driver; export controls on China semiconductor customers and cyclical slowdown in AI spend are the main swing factors.
